clientCertificate.description: Verified enrolled certificate public-key identity; role and scope checked per operation.

holdCommands.description: Sorted command operation IDs for completed HOLD commands.

document.description: Exact canonical signed document bytes. Signatures and embedded format are validated independently; no credentials or paths.

Signed outpost-management-report-1 through report-6. Version2 carries scrub/maintenance, version3 adds trusted restore, version4 adds unavailable catalog metadata, version5 adds original-age external-copy receipts, and version6 adds scheduled audit observations. Original times, sequence and exact tenant/domain scope are required.

inventoryState.description: Missing in an older report means unknown, never an empty healthy inventory.

externalState.description: The worker inspected its retained external-copy receipts. This is not a fresh probe of cloud health; absence in older report formats is unknown.

externalCopies.description: Historical readbacks per upload operation. Each operation/generation must match an UPLOAD job. Multiple observations of one target are not distinct copies.

scope.description: Physical/free bytes describe the entire admitted filesystem, which may contain other applications.

accountedBytes.description: Conservative Outpost allocation ledger, separate from filesystem physical use.

logicalBytes.description: Null means unknown; ciphertext bytes or missing progress must not be presented as a known value.

metadataState.description: Only report4/view4 and generation page2. Catalog is unreadable; zero creation/object values are unknown, not measured empty values.

completedBytes.description: Null means unknown; ciphertext bytes or missing progress must not be presented as a known value.

authority.description: Canonical owner-signed outpost-command-authority-1 grant for this service, node, tenant/domain/repository/writer epoch and command kind.

expectedConfigurationRevision.description: Exact owner-policy revision observed by the operator; stale commands cannot silently apply to a replacement policy.

maintenancePermit.description: Separate domain maintenance permit; required only for maintenance and verified independently by the worker.

retentionGrant.description: Separate maintenance-signed HOLD, CLOSE or RELEASE grant; required only for retention.

CommandObservation.description: Historical node observation, separate from backup jobs and audit acknowledgement. Verification and completion times retain their original age; counts and kind-specific outcomes are validated by the signed-report reader.

retentionProof.description: Original canonical node-signed receipt of a completed retention command. Decoded bytes match resultDigest.

cleanupPending.description: Owned source pin/reservation cleanup remains pending; never means restored/staged bytes were deleted.

MaintenanceOutcome.description: Original frozen GC outcome. Absent plus protected equals the candidate count. Absence is not physical erasure; a completed replay performs no new deletion.

RecoverySummary.description: Actual selected output counts; total entries must be between 1 and 32768.

RecoveryOutcome.description: Historical opaque trusted recovery receipt. Binding must equal the command envelope digest; operation, generation and original verification time must match the observation. No paths or keys.

DomainPolicy.description: At most 2 MiB encoded JSON. Opaque selected-domain assignments only, without endpoints, credentials, private paths or other-domain configuration. Historical inactive policy is not an active route. Grants are filtered by current actor role, current enrollment/policy and signer. Every mutation is authorized again. This view is not a signed configuration or proof of backup coverage.

ExternalAuditObservation.description: One scheduled result per current target. Successful observations keep the oldest supporting read. Expiry never renews with report delivery.

verifiedUnix.description: Original oldest supporting target read time; never refreshed by report delivery. Must not exceed the job update or report observation time.
